descriptions.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.
The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
Der Anwender greift mit gewaltigen Psycho-Kräften an. Die AP der letzten Attacke des Zieles werden um 3 Punkte gesenkt.
The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target’s last move.

Il Pokémon attacca con i suoi potenti poteri psichici. Sottrae tre PP all’ultima mossa usata dal nemico.
